DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 用紙のどの部分でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the form is giving you trouble?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この欄の見出しです。日本語が分からないのではなく、コピーが薄くて文字を読み取れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 言語の不理解ではなく薄い印刷が読めないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The heading for this field. It is not that I do not understand Japanese; the copy is too faint to read the letters.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot read the faint printing, rather than not understanding the language. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ほかの見出しも薄いですね。何を記入する欄か、推測して書いた所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The other headings are faint too. Have you guessed what any fields were for and filled them in?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、読める名前の欄だけ書きました。読めない所に住所を入れてよいか分からず、空けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 読める欄だけ記入し不明欄を推測していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I only filled in the name field, which I could read. I did not know whether my address belonged in the unreadable part, so I left it blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you only completed readable fields and did not guess what the unclear ones meant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでしたら、鮮明な用紙と見比べましょう。お持ちの用紙はそのまま残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us compare it with a clear form. Please keep your current form as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。もう書いた名前を消さず、元の用紙と新しい用紙を並べて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記入済み用紙を残し鮮明な用紙と比べたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I would like to compare the original and new forms side by side without erasing the name I have already written.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to keep the completed form and compare it with a clearly printed one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ手続きの用紙かも確認します。版や欄の順番が違うと、そのまま同じ位置へ写せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also check whether they are for the same procedure. If the version or field order differs, you cannot simply copy into the same positions.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。上から何番目という位置だけでなく、欄の名前を確かめて写します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用紙の版や欄の順序が違う可能性を考慮する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will check the field names before copying, rather than just their positions counted from the top.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Allow for possible differences in form versions and field order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この場面では担当者が用紙の版と記入内容を確認して、読みやすい用紙をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: In this situation, the person in charge will check the form version and information to enter, then direct you to a readable form.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。二枚の内容を確かめてから必要な所を書き、元の紙も担当者に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 欄名と内容を確認して転記し元の用紙も提示すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. After checking the contents of both sheets, I will complete the necessary parts and show the original to the person in charge too.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check field names and contents before copying, and show the original form too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。薄いコピーはそのままお持ちになり、担当窓口で鮮明な用紙と確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Keep the faint copy as it is and compare it with a clear form at the appropriate counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは息子さんのお名前ですが、本日の予約は娘さんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your son's name, but today's appointment is for your daughter, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。同じ封筒に二人分を入れていて、上の紙だけ渡してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 兄妹の用紙を同じ封筒で取り違えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. I put both children's papers in one envelope and handed over just the top sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mixed up the siblings' forms stored in one envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 娘さんの名前の用紙もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you also have the form with your daughter's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、この下にあります。ただ、記入した質問の答えも兄の方に書いたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正しい用紙を示し回答も混ざった可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it is underneath. But I may also have written the answers to the questions on her brother's form.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the correct form and say the answers may have become mixed up too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二人の体調や履歴を混ぜずに確認しましょう。記入済みの内容をそのまま娘さんのものにはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check without mixing up the two children's health and histories. We cannot simply treat the completed information as your daughter's.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。娘の分は本人について確認し直します。兄の紙から写さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別人の回答を写さず本人の情報を確認し直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will check the information about my daughter again for her form. I will avoid copying from her brother's paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Recheck the person's own information without copying someone else's answers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が娘さんの用紙と記入内容を確認します。接種については、その確認後のご案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check your daughter's form and entries. Vaccination guidance will follow that check.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約があるから必ず今日受けられると決まったわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約と接種可否の確認が別だと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: So having an appointment does not mean it is already certain she can receive the vaccination today.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand booking and confirming vaccination eligibility are separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、予約の確認と接種前の確認は別です。まず正しい用紙をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct, confirming the appointment and checking before vaccination are separate. First, we will take the correct form.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。娘の用紙を出し、兄の分は別の封筒に戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 兄妹の用紙を分け正しいものを提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will give you my daughter's form and put her brother's into a separate envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the siblings' forms and submit the correct one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。娘さんの用紙で受付を確認し、担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check reception using your daughter's form and hand it to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお気づきのことがありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 滑り台の横の金具が動いて、音がします。手で締めれば使えるかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遊具の異常と自分で直そうとした考えを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The metal fitting beside the slide moves and makes a noise. I thought tightening it by hand might make it usable.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the problem with the playground equipment and your thought of fixing it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 触って直そうとせず、場所を教えてください。どちらの滑り台ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell us the location without touching it to try to repair it. Which slide is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 砂場の近くの小さい方です。階段の一番下の横にある金具です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遊具と金具の位置を具体的に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The smaller one near the sandpit. It is the metal fitting beside the bottom of the steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the equipment and the fitting's location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。周囲の利用状況も確認します。お子さんは今どこにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. We will also check how the surrounding area is being used. Where is your child now?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別のベンチにいます。見ていた子にも、そこで遊ぶのを待ってもらいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもを離れた場所で待たせていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: At a different bench. I also asked the child watching to wait before playing there.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have the children waiting away from the equipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: スタッフが確認するまで、その遊具から離れてお待ちください。音だけで原因は判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait away from that equipment until staff check it. We cannot determine the cause from the noise alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。動画を撮ろうと金具を揺らす必要もありませんね。見たことだけ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再現のために揺らさず見た事実だけ報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. There is no need to shake the fitting to film a video either. I will explain only what I saw.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report only observed facts without shaking the fitting to reproduce the problem. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、その情報で確認します。必要な対応は管理担当者が判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we will check based on that information. The manager will decide what action is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では子どもと別の場所へ移ります。確認が終わったかは、案内を見てから判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別の場所へ移り管理側の利用案内を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will move somewhere else with my child. I will check the posted guidance before deciding whether the inspection is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to move elsewhere and wait for management's usage guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現場を確認し、利用についての案内を出す担当者に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will inspect the location and contact the person who issues guidance on use.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 配膳の前に、何か確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you want to check before serving the meals?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 利用者さんが「今日は普通のご飯がいい」と言ったので、厨房に変更を伝えようと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 利用者の食事変更の希望を先輩へ報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: A resident said they wanted regular rice today, so I am thinking of telling the kitchen to change it.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the resident's request for a meal change to a senior colleague. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の食事形態は支援計画に合わせています。希望を聞いただけで変更は決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The current meal texture follows the support plan. We cannot decide to change it just because we heard a request.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 希望は伝える必要がありますが、私が勝手に普通のご飯に替えるわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望の伝達と変更決定を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I need to pass on the request, but that does not mean I can change it to regular rice on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish passing on a request from deciding to make a change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。誰から、いつ、どう言われたかを担当者に報告してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. Tell the person in charge who said what to you and when.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 佐藤さんから今、配膳前に言われました。理由はまだ聞いていないので、分かる範囲で報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 誰がいつ何と言ったかを推測なしで伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Mr. Sato just told me before meal service. I have not asked the reason yet, so I will report what I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report who said what and when, without speculation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者がご本人の希望と現在の指示を確認します。準備中の食事はどうしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the resident's wishes and current instructions. What is happening with the meal being prepared?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ配っていません。変更が決まったと思って別の食事を渡さず、担当者の確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認前に別の食事を配らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not served it yet. I will wait for the person in charge to check, without assuming a change is decided and handing over a different meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not serve a different meal before confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ご本人には、希望を担当者に伝えたことを説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Please explain to the resident that their request has been passed to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。「普通のご飯に変わります」と約束せず、確認中だと伝えて戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更を約束せず確認中だと利用者へ説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will tell them it is being checked, without promising a change to regular rice, and then come back.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain to the resident that it is being checked, without promising a change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。報告を受けた担当者へ引き継ぎ、配膳の指示を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. Let us hand this over to the person who received the report and check the meal-service instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided on your order?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 四人分の温かい大皿を頼みたいです。今は二人ですが、あと二人も来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現在の人数と大皿の予定人数を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a hot sharing platter for four. There are only two of us now, but two more will come.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the current party size and the planned number for the platter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 後のお二人は、何時ごろ到着予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Around what time do you expect the other two to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電車が遅れていて、まだ分かりません。大皿だけ先に作って待ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着時刻が不明な友人のため保管を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Their train is delayed, so I do not know yet. Could you prepare just the platter first and hold it for us?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about keeping a platter for friends whose arrival time is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出来上がった料理を長く保管する約束はできません。全員がそろってから注文する方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot promise to hold prepared food for a long time. You could also order once everyone arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では大皿の調理はまだ始めないでください。今いる二人で食べる小皿を先に選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大皿の調理を保留し現在の二人の小皿へ切り替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then please do not start cooking the platter yet. We will first choose small dishes for the two of us here.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put the platter's preparation on hold and switch to small dishes for the two people present. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。大皿はまだ注文として確定せず、小皿だけ伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. We will not confirm the platter as an order yet; I will take only your small-dish order.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小皿を二つお願いします。後から来る友人の分まで追加されないよう、今は二人用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小皿の数と現在の人数だけの注文を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two small dishes, please. This is just for the two of us now, so please do not add portions for our friends who will come later.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the number of small dishes and that the order is only for those currently present. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、小皿二つですね。大皿は到着後に改めてご注文ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, two small dishes. Please order the platter again after your friends arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人にも、大皿はまだ頼んでいないので、着いてから相談すると連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人へ大皿は未注文だと伝え到着後に相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will tell my friends we have not ordered the platter yet and will discuss it after they arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to tell your friends the platter is not ordered yet and discuss it after arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。今回は小皿二つを厨房へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. For now, I will send the kitchen an order for two small dishes.

DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 傘の骨の修理についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss repairing an umbrella rib, correct?

DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。修理が千円なら、千五百円の新品より安いので直したいです。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 修理代と新品価格から判断した理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If repairs cost one thousand yen, that is cheaper than a new one at fifteen hundred yen, so I would like it repaired.
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your reasoning based on the repair cost and new-item price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 千円は一本の骨だけを交換する場合の目安です。この傘は別の部分も確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-03.translation: One thousand yen is an estimate for replacing just one rib. Other parts of this umbrella also need checking.

DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 目安を総額だと思っていました。取っ手のぐらつきも見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 修理の目安と総額を区別し別の不具合も伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the estimate was the total. Could you also check the loose handle?
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish an estimated repair cost from the total and mention another fault. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。両方を点検してから、修理できる範囲と見積もりをお伝えします。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. After inspecting both, we will explain what can be repaired and give you a quote.

DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それまで作業は始めず、見積もりを聞いてから修理するか決めたいです。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見積もりへの同意前に作業を始めないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do not start work until then. I want to decide whether to repair it after hearing the quote.
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them not to begin work before you agree to the quote. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。お預かりする場合、今日そのまま持ち帰ることはできません。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. If you leave it with us, you will not be able to take it home today.

DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日の通勤で使いたいので、先に預かる期間も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な日に間に合うか預かり期間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to use it to commute tomorrow, so I would also like to know how long you would keep it first.
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how long they would keep it and whether it would be ready when needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 点検は今日中、修理には数日かかる設定です。新品なら今日お持ち帰りになれます。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-09.translation: In this situation, inspection finishes today, but repairs take several days. A new umbrella can be taken home today.

DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時間も考えると新品を選びたいです。古い傘は修理に預けず持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 納期を考慮して新品を買い旧品は持ち帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Considering the time too, I would like a new one. I will take the old umbrella home rather than leave it for repair.
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consider the completion time and decide to buy new and take the old item home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。修理は受け付けず、新品の傘をご案内します。
DLG-SC-CHB-KASHIWA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will not accept it for repair and will show you new umbrellas.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 追加の飲み物代は三百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: The extra drink costs three hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カレーの食券もここにあります。カレー代と合わせて払えばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食券の食事代も会計するのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I also have the curry meal ticket here. Should I pay for the curry together with it?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the meal covered by the meal ticket also needs paying for at checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食券を購入した時に、カレー代はお支払いいただいています。今回は飲み物だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You paid for the curry when you bought the meal ticket. This payment is only for the drink.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでした。食券が手元にあるので、まだ払っていないと思ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手元の食券を未払いだと誤解したことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That is right. Because I still had the meal ticket, I thought I had not paid yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook having the meal ticket for not having paid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食券は注文を確認するためにお返ししたものです。追加した物は飲み物一つですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We returned the meal ticket to confirm the order. Your only addition was one drink, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、友人の注文とは別です。友人が追加したデザートまで私の分に入っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の追加注文が混ざっていないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, separate from my friend's order. Has the dessert my friend added been included in mine?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether your friend's additional order has been mixed into your bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お客様の追加分は飲み物だけです。友人のデザートは別の伝票にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your only addition is the drink. Your friend's dessert is on a separate bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。カレー代を含めない明細で、飲み物一つを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食事代を含めない追加分の明細を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I would like to check one drink on an itemized bill that does not include the curry.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an itemized breakdown of the additions excluding the meal charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの明細に、追加の飲み物三百円と記載しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: This breakdown says additional drink, three hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。三百円だけ払います。食券は返した方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲み物代だけを支払い食券の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked. I will pay just three hundred yen. Should I return the meal ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay only for the drink and check what to do with the meal ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この場面では食券を回収します。お支払い三百円をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: In this situation, we collect the meal ticket. I will take your three hundred yen payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 古い端末の初期化もご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you also like to discuss resetting your old device?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。新しい端末に写真が見えるので、古い方はもう消してもいいと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新端末に写真が見えるため旧端末を消したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I can see the photos on my new device, so I think I can erase the old one now.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to erase the old device because photos are visible on the new one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見えていても、端末に保存された写真か、通信で表示している写真かは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even if they are visible, photos stored on the device and photos displayed over a network are different things.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古い端末から全部移ったとは限らないんですね。どの保存先か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示と保存の違いを理解し保存先の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So that does not necessarily mean everything has transferred from the old device. I would like to check where they are stored.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand the difference between display and storage, and ask to check the storage location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存先と同期の状態を一緒に確認できます。設定画面を開く操作はご本人にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can check the storage location and sync status together. Please open the settings screen yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。暗証番号は私が入力します。消去の操作はまだしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 暗証番号を自分で入力し消去を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will enter the passcode myself. Please do not perform any erasing yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Enter the passcode yourself and put erasing on hold. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認すると、一部の写真はクラウド上だけにある表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. On checking, some photos are shown as being only in the cloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 旅行中は通信できないこともあるので、大事な写真を端末に保存する方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通信なしで必要な写真を見るため保存方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I sometimes have no connection while traveling, so I would like to know how to save important photos on the device.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to save photos you need to see without a connection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 機種の設定を確認して方法をご案内します。保存後は、写真が開けるかご自身で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check your model's settings and explain how. After saving, check yourself that the photos open.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。必要な写真と連絡先を確認してから、古い端末を消すか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真と連絡先を確認するまで初期化しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the photos and contacts I need before deciding whether to erase the old device.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to reset until you have checked your photos and contacts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は初期化せず、保存先の確認と保存方法の案内を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will not reset it today and will proceed with checking storage locations and explaining how to save.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどのお電話で、三十分延長と承りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: On the phone earlier, we took your request for a thirty-minute extension.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 延長を頼んだつもりはありません。飲み物が届くか聞かれたと思って「はい」と答えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話への返事が延長希望ではなかったと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I did not mean to ask for an extension. I thought you were asking whether the drinks had arrived, and answered yes.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the misunderstanding that your phone reply meant you wanted an extension. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お電話は終了時刻の確認でした。まだ延長時間は始まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The call was to confirm your finish time. The extension period has not started yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら、元の終了時刻のままに戻してもらえますか。友人にも帰る時間を伝えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 延長開始前に元の終了時刻へ戻すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then could you restore the original finish time? I have also told my friends when we are leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to restore the original finish time before the extension begins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では延長を取り消せます。元の終了時刻は四時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this situation, we can cancel the extension. Your original finish time is four.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。飲み物を待っていることとは、別の話として確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時間変更と飲み物の確認を分けて依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I would like to check that separately from the matter of waiting for the drinks.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the time change and the drinks separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 飲み物の注文は厨房で確認します。延長の取り消しと一緒に注文を取り消す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the drink order with the kitchen. You do not need to cancel the order along with the extension.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飲み物はまだ欲しいですが、四時までに出せないなら、対応を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 終了までに飲み物を提供できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I still want the drinks, but if they cannot be served before four, please tell me what can be done.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the drinks can be served before the finish time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提供できるか確認して、改めてお知らせします。今は延長だけ取り消しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check whether they can be served and let you know. For now, we have canceled only the extension.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。終了は四時、飲み物は確認待ちですね。次は聞き取れなければ聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定した終了時刻と確認中の注文を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. The finish is four, and the drinks are awaiting confirmation. Next time I will ask again if I cannot make out what is said.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Clarify the confirmed finish time and the order still being checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その内容で承っています。飲み物の確認結果はスタッフからお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, that is what we have recorded. A staff member will tell you the result of the drink check.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次は「休日の過ごし方」を一分ほど話しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Next, let us speak for about a minute about how you spend your days off.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 教科書の例文をそのまま読めばいいですか。もう読めるように練習しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 例文の音読でよいか課題を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Should I just read the textbook example aloud as it is? I have already practiced until I can read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether reading the example aloud satisfies the assignment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回は例文の音読ではなく、自分の休日について話す練習です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This time, the practice is to talk about your own days off rather than read the example aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 旅行の話がありません。近所で洗濯したり買い物したりする内容でもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日常的な休日の内容でも使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have no travel stories. Is it all right to talk about doing laundry and shopping in my neighborhood?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether ordinary day-off activities are acceptable content. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: もちろんです。実際の経験を一つ選び、何をしたかと理由を話してみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. Choose one actual experience and try to explain what you did and why.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 全部の休日を並べるより、先週の日曜日に買い物した話を一つ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 話す経験を一つに絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than listing all my days off, I will choose one story about shopping last Sunday.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Narrow your story to one experience. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いいですね。全部の文章を書くより、思い出すための短いメモにしてみませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That sounds good. How about brief notes to remind you, rather than writing out every sentence?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では「雨」「近くの店」「夕食」の三つをメモします。知らない単語は質問してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短いメモを作り準備中の単語質問を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will note three things: rain, nearby shop, and dinner. May I ask about words I do not know?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make short notes and check whether you can ask vocabulary questions while preparing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、準備中に質問できます。話している間は、分かる言葉で言い換えてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can ask during preparation. While speaking, try rephrasing with words you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。例文を読むのではなく、メモを見ながら自分の経験を話してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 音読から自分の経験を話す練習へ切り替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Instead of reading the example, I will try speaking about my own experience while looking at my notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Switch from reading aloud to practicing talking about your own experience. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では準備のあと、あなたの話から始めましょう。途中で言い直しても大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-KASHIWA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then after preparation, we will start with your story. It is all right to correct yourself as you speak.
